title: Writing an Iterator

writing.exampleCaption: Only `next` is written; `take` and `sum` come for free.
writing.explanation: Iterator requires only next(); everything else — map, filter, take, zip, sum — arrives as default methods. That is why a custom sequence composes with the standard library exactly like a Vec does, without any of it knowing your type exists.
writing.feedback: None ends the iteration, and every adapter respects it.
writing.question: What signals that the sequence has finished?
writing.rule: Implement next(); the adapters are default methods on the trait.
writing.success: It works with at least one adapter you did not write.
writing.summary: Implementing one method gives you the whole adapter library.
